equivalence_rule.classification: generated_or_hidden iff normalized class name contains /0x, contains $$Lambda, starts jdk.proxy, contains Generated, or source is one of __dynamic_proxy__, __ClassDefiner__, __JVM_LookupDefineClass__
equivalence_rule.required_unique_family_equality: Exact set equality of (normalized_name, source) for every generated_or_hidden class.
equivalence_rule.required_non_vm_multiplicity_equality: Exact multiset equality of (normalized_name, source) for generated_or_hidden classes whose source is not __JVM_LookupDefineClass__.
equivalence_rule.vm_hidden_rule: For source __JVM_LookupDefineClass__, exact unique normalized family-set equality is required but multiplicity may vary between repeats. Raw rows, counts and multiplicity deltas remain preserved.
equivalence_rule.ordinary_classes: Ordinary non-generated class-load multiplicity/order is preserved as raw evidence but is not a generated/hidden equivalence criterion.
equivalence_rule.input_binding: The rule is usable only when immutable image/JDK, source/build inputs, dependency-store bytes, normalized runtime graph, worker Java, test class and generator/tool inputs all rehash identically.

fail_closed: Any generated/hidden unique family present in only one repeat fails.
Any non-VM generated multiplicity difference fails.
Any VM hidden family-set difference fails.
Any runtime graph, dependency-store, source/build input, Java/tool or fixed-worker drift fails independently.
No family may be silently excluded after classification.
preservation: all-class normalized digest for each repeat
generated/hidden unique-family digest for each repeat
non-VM generated multiset digest for each repeat
VM lookup-defined unique-family digest and raw multiplicity counts for each repeat
explicit_non_authority: No expected manifest, prepared worker, R1 permit, seed, claim, allocation or gameplay authority.
next_gate: Independent review of this exact equivalence rule. Only if accepted may the capture validator be changed to implement it and a fresh successor original be dispatched.
